sponsored.t: Relates to the Islip Terrace Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association
sponsored.sum: Relates to the Islip Terrace Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association; makes technical amendments to the chapter incorporating such association.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Church of Pentecost, USA, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Church of Pentecost, USA, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for parcels located in the county of Suffolk.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting and regulating marine transportation network companies
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and regulates the operation of marine transportation network companies outside of a city of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to voting by the senate on nominations of the governor
sponsored.sum: Requires that each appointment to an office by the governor by and with the advice and consent of the senate shall be voted on individually by the senate; provides that nominations may not be considered, confirmed or rejected as a slate or group; requires that all votes be conducted with a roll call vote with each senator's vote noted on the record.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Michael J. Cappiello to purchase service credit for service with the Long Island Railroad Company police department
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Michael J. Cappiello to purchase service credit for service with the Long Island Railroad Company police department prior to its merger with the MTA and the state retirement system.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the use of certain moneys received by the Bohemia Volunteer Firefighter's Benevolent Association
sponsored.sum: Relates to the application of certain provisions relating to the use of certain moneys received by the Bohemia Volunteer Firefighter's Benevolent Association to taxes due on premiums received before January 1, 2026.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Carl Spatola to receive a refund from the New York state teachers' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Carl Spatola to receive a refund from the New York state teachers' retirement system due to overpayment.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Brian Landers
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Brian Landers, for his employment with the village of Lindenhurst which commenced June 19, 2006.

sponsored.t: Allows the legislature to authorize pool-selling without profit
sponsored.sum: Allows the legislature to authorize pool-selling without profit.

sponsored.t: Requires the governor and senior state officers to appear before the legislature
sponsored.sum: Requires the governor and senior state officers to appear before the legislature as requested by the legislature to publicly explain actions and answer questions.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the governor, the legislature and state agencies from imposing residential housing zoning requirements on local governments without approval from the local government
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the governor, the legislature and state agencies from imposing residential housing zoning requirements on local governments without approval from the local government.

sponsored.t: Relates to the appointment of commissioners for the Seaview/Ocean Bay Park garbage district
sponsored.sum: Provides that the Seaview/Ocean Bay Park garbage district shall have 7 commissioners; provides for the requirements for appointment of such commissioners.

sponsored.t: Allows bars and restaurants to organize and manage sports squares pools
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Allows bars and restaurants to organize and manage sports squares pools, provided that they do not take any profit from such pools.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the governor from preventing or inhibiting state agency cooperation with the federal government for the purposes of immigration enforcement
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the governor from preventing or inhibiting state agency cooperation with the federal government for the purposes of immigration enforcement; prohibits state agencies from preventing or inhibiting collaboration with federal agencies for the purposes of federal immigration enforcement.

sponsored.t: Requires law enforcement and courts to notify the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency when an arrested person or defendant is not a United States citizen; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires law enforcement and courts to notify the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency (ICE) when an arrested person or defendant is not a United States citizen; adjusts certain maximum sentences for class A misdemeanors and unclassified misdemeanors; requires notification to be made to the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency prior to the release of certain noncitizens; repeals provisions of the "protect our courts act".

sponsored.t: Relates to withholding the governor's salary after the April first budget deadline until a state budget has been passed
sponsored.sum: Relates to withholding the governor's salary after the April first budget deadline until a state budget has been passed.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of a waiver for child care learning pods
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of a waiver for child care learning pods; provides that unlicensed and unregulated child care learning pods may operate if there are otherwise no violations of laws or codes, rules, and regulations of New York and such child care learning pod is compliant with the local laws, codes, rules, and regulations of such local municipality in which they are located and operated; provides for civil penalty for violations.

sponsored.t: Protects the identity of witnesses of hate crimes in discovery proceedings
sponsored.sum: Protects the identity of witnesses of hate crimes in discovery proceedings by requiring identifying information to be redacted, unless the court rules otherwise for good cause shown.

sponsored.t: Requires public utility authorities to obtain legislative approval before raising rates or fees, or imposing new rates or fees
sponsored.sum: Requires public utility authorities to obtain legislative approval before raising rates or fees, or imposing new rates or fees.

sponsored.t: Relates to exemptions from sales and use taxes for gift certificates, electronic gift cards and magnetic gift cards
sponsored.sum: Relates to exemptions from sales and use taxes for gift certificates, electronic gift cards and magnetic gift cards.

sponsored.t: Allows reservists who have served or who are currently serving in the United States armed forces to be eligible for 2.5 points on civil service examinations
sponsored.sum: Allows reservists who have served or who are currently serving in the United States armed forces to be eligible for 2.5 points on civil service examinations.

sponsored.t: Provides real property tax relief to certain veterans
sponsored.sum: Provides real property tax relief to veterans who have at least ten years of service in the U.S. armed forces or in the organized militia of the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Requires the office of children and family services implement a regional cost factor analysis for child care subsidies
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of children and family services implement a regional cost factor analysis for child care subsidies; requires social services districts implement such findings.

sponsored.t: Directs the office of mental health to develop materials relating to suicide prevention for school-aged children; authorizes school districts to include suicide prevention in health class curriculum
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of mental health to develop materials relating to suicide prevention and identifying signs of depression for school-aged children; authorizes school districts to include suicide prevention in health class curriculum.

sponsored.t: Establishes a no fare program for transportation on the Long Island Rail Road for individuals in active military service of the United States and active duty members of the New York national guard
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority, in consultation with the Long Island Rail Road, to establish a no fare program for transportation on the Long Island Rail Road for individuals in active military service of the United States and active duty members of the New York national guard, upon showing a military or national guard identification card.

sponsored.t: Provides for the appeal of disputes between shareholders and boards of directors of residential cooperative corporations to a hearing officer appointed by the attorney general
sponsored.sum: Provides for the appeal of disputes between shareholders and boards of directors of residential cooperatives to a hearing officer appointed by the attorney general.

sponsored.t: Relates to raising the income cap for senior citizens applying for the enhanced STAR property tax exemption
sponsored.sum: Relates to raising the income cap for senior citizens applying for the enhanced STAR property tax exemption to $120,000.

sponsored.t: Establishes a coordinated law enforcement adult rescue "teal alert" for missing adults
sponsored.sum: Establishes a coordinated law enforcement adult rescue "teal alert" for missing adults; provides that local law enforcement agencies notify the division of criminal justice services about missing adults; provides that such division shall issue an alert about such missing adult.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive retirement membership in the New York state teachers' retirement system to Eileen Saumell
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive retirement membership in the New York state teachers' retirement system to Eileen Saumell.

sponsored.t: Relates to healthy school meals
sponsored.sum: Relates to purchases of food products for school meals from New York state farmers, growers, producers or processors; prohibits sale of school foods containing certain synthetic color additives; establishes a "healthy kitchens, healthy schools program" to provide grants for kitchen upgrades; prohibits school meals from containing more than 25 grams of added sugars per day, in aggregate.

sponsored.t: Enacts "Stella's law" requiring a CPR certified staff member to be present in school cafeterias during lunchtimes
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Stella's law"; requires a staff member certified in first aid, CPR, and the Heimlich maneuver to be present in school cafeterias during lunchtimes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of certain moneys received by the Bohemia volunteer firefighter's association, and modernization of certain language
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of moneys received from foreign fire insurance companies by the Bohemia Volunteer Firefighter's Benevolent Association, and to modernization of certain language by making such language gender neutral.
